title: Better Bread
description: This mod adds 3 new types of bread to your game and makes them more tasty.
body:
Better Bread makes your bread even more tasty:)

## Includes

- Edible Bread
- Block of Bread
- Toast
- Burned Toast

**This mod is still a work in progress!**

### Creative Tabs

- Building Blocks
- Food & Drinks

You can find the items in those sections.
